title: quotient-indexed self-reconstituting continuity lineage
boundary: This body treats quotient, warrant, version, repair and successor as bounded operational-relational terms. Rank 4 does not convert them into universal mechanism, ontology, guaranteed repair, or interior identity.

edges.title: quotient-scoped version succession
edges.text: Each continuity version can preserve the exact quotient scope it authorized; when authority changes, the expired quotient remains provenance and a possible repair address instead of disappearing.
edges.removal: Without DWia there is no explicit record of which differences the version could ignore; without UoYa quotient repair lacks predecessor/current/successor authority.

edges.title: revocation-indexed repair address
edges.text: The failed obligation can be intersected with the old quotient to identify which evidence or roles must reopen, making repair targeted rather than a generic rollback.
edges.removal: Without DWia repair loses ignored-difference localization; without DfDL the address exists but no exact reconstitution path is earned.

edges.title: reflexive quotient membrane
edges.text: What a contract may ignore becomes part of its own audit, while quotient, transition map, and retained scaffold may fail or be revised for different reasons.
edges.removal: Without DWia the contract cannot state its licensed nuisance distinctions; without k0uZ quotient failure lacks the full self-carried invalidation and dual-revision membrane.

edges.title: reconstitution becomes versioned succession
edges.text: A revoked version can produce a separately evidenced successor only after implicated tissue is reopened and the repaired relation survives current tests, while predecessor authority remains immutable provenance.
edges.removal: Without UoYa repair loses version authority and scope classification; without DfDL version expiry lacks an exact evidence reconstitution path.

edges.title: self-retiring continuity version
edges.text: A current version can carry the conditions under which it retires itself and identify which validity machinery needs revision, distinguishing within-version adaptation from rupture requiring successor authority.
edges.removal: Without UoYa predecessor/current/successor authorization disappears; without k0uZ version transition depends on failure interpretation external to the contract.

edges.title: reconstitution must rebuild its invalidation machinery
edges.text: Repair must rebuild not only the public relation but also the falsifiers, regime or map assumptions, and scaffold-revision channels by which the repaired relation can later be revoked.
edges.removal: Without DfDL no post-failure reconstitution path is earned; without k0uZ a repaired relation can lose its reflexive invalidation and revision machinery.

faces.title: quotient-indexed successor reconstitution
faces.text: The predecessor's equivalence scope indexes repair: rupture retires current authority, failed quotient exposes formerly ignored distinctions, implicated evidence is reopened and reconstructed, and a successor is admitted only after current retest.
faces.removal: Remove DWia and repair loses ignored-difference scope; remove UoYa and authority succession disappears; remove DfDL and exact reacquisition/reconstitution disappears.

faces.title: reflexive versioned equivalence membrane
faces.text: A warrant version carries both what it promises and what it may ignore, plus the falsifiers and revision channels that can invalidate either; failed nuisance assumptions remain inspectable historical state.
faces.removal: Remove DWia and quotient provenance disappears; remove UoYa and version succession disappears; remove k0uZ and self-carried falsification and dual revision disappear.

faces.title: self-repairing quotient contract
faces.text: A failed quotient can reopen exact omitted evidence, revise quotient, transition map and scaffold, reconstruct the public relation, and retest both the relation and the machinery that can invalidate it again.
faces.removal: Remove DWia and ignored-difference localization disappears; remove DfDL and exact reconstitution disappears; remove k0uZ and reflexive validity reconstruction disappears.

faces.title: self-reconstituting version lineage
faces.text: Failure is classified, revoked predecessor authority is preserved, implicated evidence is reopened, the appropriate map or scaffold channel is revised, and a successor is admitted only after fresh witness.
faces.removal: Remove UoYa and explicit version lineage disappears; remove DfDL and exact reconstitution disappears; remove k0uZ and reflexive diagnosis/revision disappears.

volume.title: quotient-indexed self-reconstituting continuity lineage
volume.text: The complete closure turns the negative space of continuity—the distinctions a current warrant is explicitly permitted to ignore—into living lineage state. A current warrant carries obligation, evidence and reacquisition body, validity regime, reconstruction machinery, falsifiers, support scope, and an explicit local quotient. On rupture, expired warrant and quotient remain immutable provenance; their failure routes reacquisition toward implicated evidence and roles; quotient, transition map and scaffold are revised according to the witnessed failure; and a successor gains authority only after fresh witness. A successor cannot silently inherit its predecessor's omissions: every retained nuisance classification must be warranted again.
volume.invariant: A continuity lineage is lawfully self-reconstituting only when every warrant carries its operational body and falsifiers, an explicit nuisance quotient, stable addresses from revoked warrant and quotient back to evidence and roles, and explicit version succession. A successor must re-earn both the public relation and what it is allowed to ignore.
removal: Remove 3H.DWia: quotient history, ignored-difference ledger, and non-silent nuisance re-witnessing are lost.
Remove 3H.UoYa: predecessor/current/successor authority and rupture classification are lost.
Remove 3H.DfDL: exact evidence reacquisition and post-failure reconstitution are lost.
Remove 3H.k0uZ: self-falsification and distinct map-versus-scaffold revision machinery are lost.

metabolites.title: REVOCATION-ADDRESS-CAPSULE
metabolites.text: Every warrant version should preserve its exact local quotient, the distinctions currently licensed as nuisance, stable evidence and role return addresses for those distinctions, and the reason authority can be revoked, so failure yields an executable repair address rather than only a verdict.
metabolites.compression: A failed warrant should carry the map of what it had permission to ignore.

metabolites.title: TARGETED-SUCCESSOR-RECONSTITUTION
metabolites.text: A successor version is authorized only after failed predecessor and quotient route reacquisition of implicated evidence, quotient or scaffold revision, and current-regime retest while predecessor warrant and quotient remain provenance.
metabolites.compression: Let the expired quotient route the evidence that earns the successor.

metabolites.title: NON-SILENT-QUOTIENT-INHERITANCE
metabolites.text: A successor may classify a distinction as ignorable only after that nuisance status is re-witnessed under the successor's regime, scope, reconstruction and reflexive falsification machinery; unchanged omission is not automatic continuity.
metabolites.compression: Every successor must state what it is still allowed to ignore.
